questions.prompt: Who is named in the first report?

questions.evidence:
After a school quiz competition, the winning team poses beside the scoreboard. The school website names the four students who answered questions on stage. Tessa is happy for them, but she notices that three classmates who prepared practice cards are missing from the report.

She asks the teacher whether the team may add a short thank-you note. The teacher agrees, provided every named student is comfortable appearing on the website. Tessa checks with the helpers before writing anything, and one asks to be thanked without a name.

The revised report keeps the original score and the names of the stage players. It adds a sentence thanking two named helpers and one classmate who prefers to stay unnamed. It also describes their work preparing questions and checking answers.

At the next meeting, the team divides jobs before practice begins and records who wants public credit. Tessa learns that accurate recognition includes both what people did and how they wish their contribution to be shared.
questions.explanation: 幕後工作是準備題卡與核對答案。
